scope: Offline constant-rectangle half-space compliance at the saved actual P2 gap. Tangential traction is prescribed proportional to pressure using the observed resultant ratio, with a reversed-traction control. A nonsymmetric force-controlled complementarity solve includes Cerruti normal displacement. This is a declared proportional-traction sensitivity model, without stick/slip history or hollow-shell compliance. Original native refusal and all physical-pressure/peak qualifications remain open.
cheap_pressure_model: From the plane-strain derivative of the same surface kernels, lambda=1/2+atan(beta*Ft_x/Fn)/pi with beta=(1-2nu)/(2*(1-nu)). Prescribe p~((w*(1-y^2/b^2)-x)/x)^lambda; its line load is proportional to lambda*w. Keep the previously fitted normal-only along-edge extent and shift, and scale its width by0.5/lambda. No coupled-reference pressure fitting is used. The exact strip singular-integral identity is checked by independent quadrature; finite-aspect and along-edge shear errors are measured here.
